job.title: Account Manager - Commercial Insurance
job.description:
About the Role

My client is hiring an Account Manager or Senior Account Manager to join a well-established commercial insurance portfolio. This role offers the opportunity to manage a diverse client base across a range of industries while working within a supportive and collaborative broking environment.

The portfolio includes predominantly SME clients and professional services businesses, with exposure to a broad range of insurance products including Professional Indemnity, Liability, Business Pack, Property, Management Liability, Cyber and Commercial Motor.

The position is focused on servicing, retaining and growing existing client relationships. With dedicated support for new business generation and administration, the successful candidate can focus on providing quality advice, managing renewals, strengthening client relationships and identifying growth opportunities across the portfolio.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced broker looking to further develop their technical expertise and portfolio management skills within a stable and growing business.

What's on Offer

  • Manage an established portfolio of commercial insurance clients.
  • Strong internal support, including administration and account servicing assistance.
  • Exposure to a broad range of insurance products and industries.
  • Ongoing technical development and mentoring from experienced insurance professionals.
  • Opportunity to contribute to portfolio growth and client retention strategies.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities based on experience and performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of commercial insurance clients, including renewals, endorsements and policy servicing.
  • Build strong client relationships through proactive communication and quality advice.
  • Negotiate with insurers to obtain favourable outcomes for clients.
  • Identify opportunities to improve client coverage and strengthen account retention.
  • Prepare renewal strategies and insurance recommendations.
  • Provide guidance across a range of commercial insurance products.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and compliance standards.
  • Collaborate with colleagues to deliver an outstanding client experience.
  • Contribute to process improvements and servicing efficiencies where appropriate.

About You

We're interested in speaking with candidates who can demonstrate:

  • Experience in commercial insurance broking, underwriting or account management.
  • Exposure to SME and commercial insurance clients.
  • Knowledge of one or more of the following classes: Professional Indemnity, Liability, Property, Business Pack, Management Liability, Cyber or Motor.
  • Strong client relationship and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing renewals and negotiating with insurers.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • A proactive, team-oriented approach with strong attention to detail.
  • Tier 1 Insurance Broking qualification (or willingness to obtain if applicable).

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within commercial broking environments.
  • Exposure to Professional Indemnity or Financial Lines products.
  • ANZIIF qualifications or ongoing industry studies.
  • Scheme, affinity or portfolio management experience.
  • Experience using broking management systems and insurer portals.

Who Would Suit This Role?

  • An experienced Account Manager seeking a larger or more technical portfolio.
  • A Senior Account Executive ready to step into an Account Manager position.
  • A Financial Lines broker looking to broaden their exposure across commercial insurance.
  • An underwriter with strong client-facing experience seeking a move into broking.
  • A commercial broker looking for a long-term portfolio management role with growth opportunities.

job.title: Account Director
job.description:
The Opportunity

My client is hiring an experienced Account Director to join a rapidly growing brokerage business in South Australia. This is a senior leadership opportunity for an accomplished insurance professional looking to take the next step in their career while managing a substantial corporate portfolio and leading a high-performing team.

The successful candidate will inherit a significant portfolio of corporate clients, predominantly focused on Financial Lines, whilst playing a key role in client retention, portfolio growth, stakeholder engagement, and team leadership.

With a combination of local expertise and national capability, this opportunity offers exposure to complex risks, senior client relationships, and genuine career progression within a growing organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a large corporate portfolio and act as the primary relationship owner for a portfolio of key corporate clients.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships through proactive engagement and regular face-to-face interaction.
  • Lead strategic insurance programmes with a strong focus on Financial Lines.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk reviews and provide tailored insurance solutions.
  • Develop and convert growth opportunities within the existing portfolio to achieve financial targets.
  • Maintain strong insurer and stakeholder relationships.
  • Ensure all activities meet regulatory, compliance and governance requirements.
  • Oversee renewals, endorsements, new business, policy amendments, quotations and certificates of currency.
  • Support and mentor a team of Senior Account Brokers, acting as the first point of escalation for technical and client matters.

Leadership Responsibilities

This role offers direct people leadership responsibilities and would suit a broker who enjoys both client management and team development.

Reporting through the South Australian leadership team, you will:

  • Lead and mentor 3-4 Senior Account Brokers.
  • Provide technical guidance and support across the team.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for complex client and broking matters.
  • Contribute to the strategic growth and ongoing success of the broader business.

About You

You are an experienced insurance broker with a strong Financial Lines background and a proven ability to manage complex corporate client relationships.

You will bring:

  • Tier 1 Insurance Qualification.
  • Advanced knowledge of insurance products, claims, broking practices and market dynamics.
  • Strong Financial Lines expertise.
  • Demonstrated experience managing sizeable corporate portfolios.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen and decision-making capability.
  • Highly developed written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong presentation and negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to work autonomously whilst contributing to a collaborative team environment.
  • A proactive, client-facing approach focused on delivering exceptional service and outcomes.

What's on Offer

  • Senior leadership opportunity within a growing brokerage.
  • Management of a substantial corporate portfolio.
  • Hybrid working model.
  • Portfolio growth opportunities through both organic and strategic business development initiatives.
  • Leadership responsibilities with direct reports.
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities.
  • Career progression and professional development support.
  • Supportive and collaborative culture with strong leadership visibility.

job.title: Territory Business Development Manager - Foodservice
job.description:
Business Development Manager - Foodservice & FMCG
$95,000 - $115,000 + Super + Company Car

Love winning new business? Prefer being out meeting customers rather than sitting behind a desk? This could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

We're partnering with a well-established Australian business in the FMCG and foodservice sector to recruit a driven, commercially minded Business Development Manager to grow its VIC territory.

This is a genuine, hands-on new business opportunity for someone who thrives on building relationships, identifying opportunities and turning conversations into long-term commercial partnerships.
You'll have the backing of an established business, a strong product offering and the autonomy to make a real impact.

What's in it for you?

  • $90,000 - $120,000 base salary + superannuation, depending on experience.
  • Fully maintained company vehicle, with work-related expenses covered.
  • Just one day in the office per week - spend the rest of your time out in the market.
  • Autonomy to manage your territory and develop new business opportunities.
  • Represent an established Australian business with a strong market presence.
  • Supportive sales leadership that values initiative, relationships and results.
  • Opportunity to make a genuine commercial impact and grow your career.

The opportunity

We're looking for a natural hunter! someone who genuinely enjoys getting out on the road, meeting new customers, opening doors and developing new business.
You'll take ownership of a VIC territory, building relationships across foodservice, hospitality, distribution and related commercial channels.
While new business development will be your primary focus, you'll also recognise opportunities to grow existing relationships and increase customer engagement.
This is not a desk-based account management role. It's an opportunity for someone who enjoys being in the field, creating opportunities and seeing the commercial results of their efforts.

What you'll be doing

  • Proactively identify, approach and convert new business opportunities across your territory.
  • Build relationships with distributors, hospitality operators, commercial customers and key decision-makers.
  • Conduct regular face-to-face customer meetings and prospect visits.
  • Develop a healthy sales pipeline and convert opportunities into sustainable revenue.
  • Identify opportunities to grow existing customer accounts and increase product penetration.
  • Present product solutions, negotiate commercial arrangements and close new business.
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams and distribution partners to deliver an excellent customer experience.
  • Monitor market activity, competitor movements and emerging opportunities.
  • Manage your territory effectively to achieve sales, revenue and growth targets.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service through proactive communication, responsiveness and follow-through.

What we're looking for

We're particularly interested in speaking with people who have built their careers in foodservice distribution, FMCG, wholesale, hospitality supply or related field sales environments.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Proven experience in a Business Development Manager, Territory Manager, Sales Executive or field sales position.
  • A genuine track record of winning new customers and growing revenue.
  • Strong prospecting, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience selling to commercial customers, distributors or business operators.
  • The confidence to engage with customers face-to-face and identify their commercial needs.
  • Excellent responsiveness, follow-through and customer service.
  • Strong commercial awareness, including pricing, sales opportunities and account profitability.
  • The ability to manage your own schedule, territory and pipeline.
  • A current driver's licence and willingness to travel throughout your territory.

Most importantly, we're looking for attitude, drive and results!!

You don't need the most senior job title or decades of experience. If you're a proactive salesperson who consistently delivers, enjoys meeting customers and takes pride in building long-term relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

Ready for your next move?

If you're looking for a role where you can spend your time doing what you do best - developing business, building relationships and achieving results - we'd love to speak with you.

Apply now with your updated resume or send to Alex.sacro@kennedyreid.com.au
